decision.rationale: The corrected region diagnostic reverses the V2/V3 ordering, but V3 still ties complete evidence, reduces atomic recall from 2/3 to 1/3, and keeps a vision model online. Preserve the original Drop decision and select no multimodal method.
limitations: This is a no-model reanalysis of preserved rankings, not a new retrieval run.

The source result was produced from a dirty worktree whose exact source state cannot be reconstructed; its stored values match the committed single-pass legacy formula rather than the alleged nested-loop formula.
Only three failed visual cases and six controls were in scope, and every answerable scoped case declared one gold region.
The corrected multi-region one-to-one assignment semantics are unit-tested but were not exercised by this historical result.
No latency, capacity, or cost measurement was rerun.
No held-out multimodal case was read.
